A '''Human''' was a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. They were opposed to [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] studies of [[The Force/Legends|The Force]].
